text:
acme_admin: Hey — noticed our promo credits from Feb (code: WINTER50) were applied after our free-tier credits were consumed. Invoice shows promo = $0 applied, dashboard shows promo balance still >0. Can someone confirm order of burn? Org: org_9a8b7c. Screenshot: https://img.example/snap.png

jess_support: sorry for the trouble — can you confirm the account id and the exact invoice number? also approx time you saw the charges?

acme_admin: account id acct_111222, invoice inv-2026-02-12. We noticed it around 2026-02-12 18:10 UTC. Screenshot has both dashboard balances and invoice line items.

jess_support: thx — filing this and triaging. @billing-bot can you create a billing case and pull credit allocation audit for acct_111222 between 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z and 2026-02-13T00:00:00Z?

billing-bot: Created BILL-7892 for acct_111222. Audit job queued: credit_audit_job(BILL-7892). ETA ~10m.

ophelia_cs: tagging in for visibility. @mike_engineer any known races in the credit burn/priority code? we had a migration last month for promo stacking rules.

mike_engineer: looking now. quick note: system applies credits in this priority order by design: 1) dedicated credits 2) promo credits (by priority desc) 3) free-tier credits — but there was a migration where legacy free-tier credit_type had priority=0 and some promo rows were null and fell back to later ordering. will check the audit.

mike_engineer: audit output (partial):
```
org_id: org_9a8b7c
acct: acct_111222
credits_applied: [
  {type: "free_tier", amount: 12.0, applied_at: "2026-02-12T18:09:52Z", id: c_444},
  {type: "promo", promo_code: "WINTER50", amount: 50.0, applied_at: "2026-02-12T18:10:03Z", id: p_777},
]
```

mike_engineer: so in this case free_tier was applied first, then promo. That matches what acme reported. Need to confirm why promo didn't have higher priority — inspecting credits table now. Query run: `SELECT id, type, promo_code, priority, created_at FROM credits WHERE acct_id='acct_111222' ORDER BY created_at;`

mike_engineer: result: promo row had priority=NULL because migration left some legacy promos without priority set. That causes ordering fallback.

jess_support: ok that's the root cause. What's the rollback/fix path? customers expect promos to be consumed before free tier.

mike_engineer: short-term patch: backfill NULL promo priorities to default high value for active promos and re-run ledger recalculation for affected invoices. Command i ran in staging (dry-run):
```bash
-- backfill active promos
UPDATE credits SET priority=100 WHERE type='promo' AND priority IS NULL AND expires_at > now();
-- recalc ledger for invoice
CALL invoice_recalc('acct_111222', 'inv-2026-02-12');
```

billing-bot: BILL-7892 updated: task "backfill-priority" added, incident severity: low-medium, ETA for customer fix: 2026-02-13 04:00 UTC.

ophelia_cs: can we confirm whether any monetary impact occurred? customer says invoice shows promo $0 applied. If we recalculated and apply promo retroactively, will it change invoice/charge?

mike_engineer: depends — if charge already invoiced and paid, finance must issue credit or adjust next invoice. technical recalc will only change ledger allocation; downstream invoicing service needs to re-emit adjustments. I'll flag finance.

jess_support: acme_admin — we're doing a technical backfill and ledger recalculation. We'll follow up with any billing adjustments. ETA ~12h. Sorry for the disruption and thanks for the report.

acme_admin: appreciate the quick response. please CC billing team if adjustment is needed.

mike_engineer: note for internal: add migration check to CI to ensure priority is not NULL for promo rows. Also add an alert if promos have priority=NULL for >1h.

jess_support: added follow-ups to BILL-7892: - run backfill - recalc ledger - notify finance - confirm with customer and close.

ophelia_cs: FYI: will draft message to customer on potential invoice credit path once finance confirms.

billing-bot: BILL-7892: backfill completed (job id jb_993). ledger_recalc run, new allocation shows promo applied first. Posted invoice_delta: {invoice: "inv-2026-02-12", promo_applied: 50.00, balance_due_delta: -50.00}.

jess_support: updated acme_admin with results and next steps (finance will handle formal correction).

acme_admin: confirmed received notification. thank you everyone :thumbsup:
